problem:
Describe the set $S={-25,-24,-23,…}$ using a conditional definition.

$$
Q
$$
worked_solution:
The set $S$ contains all integers greater than or equal to $-25.$

Therefore, the set can be written as

$$
S={x\in Z\,:\,x\ge -25}.
$$

**Note**: This definition is not unique. For example:

- We can write $x>-26.$ This gives

$$
S={x\in Z\,:\,x>-26}.
$$
